svg.text: A hypothetical example showing how each worksheet becomes an input to the next.

g.text: SCENARIO
Maya is a freelance web developer testing one narrow service-business market instead of advertising web development for everyone.
STEP
MAYA'S WORKING OUTPUT
1 · Market
Independent roofing companies in mid-sized U.S. markets that depend on search and estimate requests.
She can identify 25 businesses through search, Maps, and contractor directories.
2 · Problem
Some companies make prospects work too hard to understand services, proof, and the next step.
Consequence: comparison shoppers may have less confidence or abandon the estimate path.
3 · Offer
Conversion-focused service-site rebuild with clearer pages, proof, estimate path, mobile UX, and analytics.
Fixed scope, with paid discovery when requirements are unclear.
4 · Message
Verified observation → reasonable business consequence → relevant improvement → offer to send two changes.
5 · Channel
Targeted outreach for 30 days, supported by referrals from local business contacts.
6 · First 25
Score prospects, research the highest-quality names, send a small first batch, record replies and objections, continue.
7 · Measurement
Compare delivered messages, replies, positive replies, calls, proposals, and wins.
Change the weakest stage instead of rewriting everything.
THE PROOF IS THE CONTINUITY
Market → Problem → Offer → Message → Channel → Action → Measurement
The guide demonstrates one connected acquisition loop rather than seven isolated marketing tips.
